messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: overnight healthscore backfill fired playbooks and caused duplicate nudges. Ops queue spiked. Anyone seen this pattern?

ajay_ops: saw alerts around 06:12 UTC. correlates with the backfill job.

ben_engineer: root cause idea: backfill writes update timestamps and our playbook runner treats that as a state change. we should gate backfill-origin updates.

taylor_prod: proposal: add suppression gate in playbook runner based on origin and a cascade window. dry-run first.

ajay_ops: ops checklist: run dry-run in staging, monitor metrics cs.playbook.suppression_candidates and cs.playbook.suppressed_count, then canary 10% by shard. rollback plan: flip mode off and requeue suppressed events.

ben_engineer: will PR flags: playbook.suppression.mode (off/dry/canary/on), playbook.suppression.cascade_window_hours, playbook.suppression.exempt_predicates. instrument structured log lines for parsing.

maria_cs: CS needs exemption for accounts in active renewal with no manual contact in 60d. will produce test cohort CSV by 17:30.

ben_engineer: sample log line (string in logs): {"ts":"2026-03-23T15:10:01Z","account_id":"12345","playbook":"renewal-nudge","decision":"suppress","reason":"origin=backfill_job_v2"}

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/healthscore-suppression -> staging at 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z (dry-run).

maria_cs: main risk: accidentally suppressing mid-market renewal outreach. mitigation: allowlist and per-account console override.

ben_engineer: will post dry-run counts in this thread after job completes.
